The '''New Caledonian Super League''' ({{langx|fr|Super Ligue de Nouvelle-Calédonie}}) is the top division of the [[Football in New Caledonia#League system|New Caledonian football league system]]. It is run by the [[New Caledonian Football Federation]].

The league is played as a double round robin between the top-4 clubs from the Division Honneur of Grande Terre and the champions of the Îles.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fedcalfoot.com/CLASSEMENT_a130.html|title=Super ligue CLASSEMENT|website=fedcalfoot.com|access-date=2021-05-05|language=en}}</ref><ref name="fedcalfoot">[https://www.fedcalfoot.com/Super-Ligue_r23.html] at CALENDRIER OFFICIEL de la SUPER LIGUE 2021</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/newcal2020.html|title=New Caledonia 2020|website=[[RSSSF]]|access-date=2021-05-03|language=en|archive-date=2022-07-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220728220310/https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/newcal2020.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
